name: Hash-Based Signature Assessment
description: Assessment of hash-based digital signature schemes including SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+), XMSS, and LMS. Covers stateful vs stateless scheme trade-offs, state management for stateful schemes, parameter selection, and compliance with NIST FIPS 205 and SP 800-208.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to hash-based signature assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands hash-based signature fundamentals and the stateful vs stateless distinction
evidence: Can explain how hash-based signatures derive their security from hash function properties
Understands the critical difference between stateful (XMSS, LMS) and stateless (SLH-DSA) schemes
Can describe why state management failure in XMSS/LMS leads to catastrophic key reuse

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies hash-based signature deployments and reviews configurations under supervision
evidence: Identifies SLH-DSA, XMSS, and LMS usage in firmware signing and certificate contexts
Reviews parameter selections (tree height, hash function) under guidance
Validates signature verification against test vectors
Documents hash-based signature findings following lab templates

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses hash-based signature implementations for correctness and safety
evidence: Evaluates SLH-DSA implementations against FIPS 205 requirements
Assesses XMSS/LMS state management for one-time signature index tracking correctness
Identifies parameter selection issues affecting signature size, generation time, or security level
Produces findings referencing FIPS 205, SP 800-208, or relevant RFCs

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex hash-based signature deployments; evaluates state management risks
evidence: Evaluates stateful scheme state persistence and backup mechanisms for fault tolerance, including the SP 800-208 requirement that key generation and signing occur in hardware cryptographic modules that do not export private keys
Assesses hash-based signatures in firmware update and code signing pipelines
Reviews SLH-DSA parameter trade-offs (speed vs size) for deployment context
Mentors junior staff on hash-based signature assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines hash-based signature assessment methodology; recognised authority on post-quantum signatures
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's hash-based signature assessment methodology
Published research on hash-based signature implementations or state management risks
Provides expert guidance on hash-based signature deployment strategies
Trains teams on hash-based signature internals and assessment approaches

assessment_methods.description: Assess a firmware signing system using XMSS: evaluate state management, key generation, and signature verification processes
Given an LMS deployment, identify state management weaknesses and propose safeguards against one-time signature index reuse
